scripts.build: mkdir -p .vercel/output/functions/api.func && bun build src/index.ts --outfile .vercel/output/functions/api.func/index.mjs --target node && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='.vercel/output/functions/api.func/index.mjs';const polyfill='if(typeof globalThis.DOMMatrix===\"undefined\"){globalThis.DOMMatrix=class DOMMatrix{};globalThis.ImageData=class ImageData{};globalThis.Path2D=class Path2D{};}\n';fs.writeFileSync(f,polyfill+fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))" && cp $(find ../../node_modules -path '*/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.mjs' -print -quit) .vercel/output/functions/api.func/pdf.worker.mjs && printf '{"runtime":"nodejs20.x","handler":"index.mjs","launcherType":"Nodejs","maxDuration":60}' > .vercel/output/functions/api.func/.vc-config.json && printf '{"version":3,"routes":[{"src":"/(.*)","dest":"/api"}]}' > .vercel/output/config.json
